outputs.title: 主玩法与整体棋盘
outputs.prompt:
Create ONE polished 16:9 GAMEPLAY CONCEPT SCREEN for an original Chinese primary-school AI literacy mini-game tentatively titled "行动工坊". Topic: people define goals, arrange actions, add rules and constraints, compare plans, try them, and take responsibility. The game is a TWO-DIMENSIONAL TOP-DOWN CAMPUS ACTION BOARD with tactile paper-cut and wooden-token details, not a freely walkable 3D town, first-person scene or forest platformer.

ART: crisp illustrated 2D board-game style, straight overhead or very mild orthographic tilt, NO horizon and NO cinematic ground-level camera. Cream paper, sky blue, soft mint, warm wood and restrained coral highlights. A friendly SMALL cream-and-blue rounded wheeled delivery robot with two dot eyes and a little book tray is a movable token, not a giant mascot portrait. Buildings are simple readable flat paper tiles/symbols, roads have clear connections. Make it appealing to 7–12-year-olds, sophisticated and readable rather than babyish. Original art, no imitation of a franchise.

CONSISTENT BOARD: the action station is lower-left; book corner upper-left; music classroom upper-right; activity square central; supply/charging point lower-right; a broad ramp connects the outer east approach to music classroom, while a short stair connection goes from center toward that classroom. A grass patch lies inside the central roads. Several safe sidewalk connections allow alternative routes. These are teaching props, not a real campus or real robot.
Use only a few important Chinese labels. Main board stays roughly 70–80% of screen, with one compact objective top and a contextual instruction/rule drawer when needed. One primary action, small sound/pause settings. Protect playfield; no equal-weight floating cards around every edge, adult data dashboard, huge logo, scoreboard, countdown, lives, combat, probability values, mathematical formulas, technical code or charts. All requested Chinese text must be short, exact, readable. No browser/device frame, watermarks or multi-screen collage. This is a visual proposal, not a fake claim of actual solver output.
Show a normal in-progress PLAY VIEW with the whole campus board visible and connected. The small delivery robot starts near the lower-left action station, empty book tray, ready to begin its task. A first-leg dotted teal preview connects toward the book corner; further possible roads remain visible, not all lit as a guaranteed solution. Two paper-student tokens wait near music classroom, and an illustrated book stack sits at the book corner. The scenery is a playful substantial tabletop GAME BOARD, not a worksheet.
A slim OPEN instruction drawer along the right holds FOUR big reorderable graphical cards in order, exactly "去图书角", "取书", "去音乐教室", "交给对方"; numbered 1–4. The first card has a soft current-selection outline. A large pointer is moving the second book card into place, revealing the player arranges the plan. Small heading on drawer "我的步骤". Board tile labels exactly "行动站", "图书角", "音乐教室", "活动广场", "补给站", and a small ramp symbol label "坡道". Avoid printing other place names.
Top-left small title "行动工坊"; top objective exactly "把图书送到音乐教室". Primary button lower-right exactly "试一试". A small secondary action near board says "看看建议". Top-right five small lesson stamp dots and sound/pause icons. Keep the entire plan interaction, starting robot, destination and possible paths readable. No trophy or pre-marked successful delivery. The board can be reused for many changing tasks; communicate a living puzzle simulation with movable pieces and editable instructions.

The routes may share the beginning and final segments, but each color must have a visible continuous connection and clear direction.
